title: emitRangeWindowOverTimeDirectInstant's window-start predicate becomes closed-left
notes: Real production seam: emitRangeWindowOverTimeDirectInstant (internal/chsql/range_window.go ~3378-3412) is the row-level WHERE that answers an instant count_over_time()/min_over_time()/max_over_time()/present_over_time() query -- the incrementally-reducible *_over_time family internal/chsql/range_window.go's emitRangeWindowOverTimeDirect routes to a direct CH aggregate rather than the groupArray+arrayFilter windowed-array path. The patch changes its start-boundary comparison from `Gt` to `Gte`, widening the (T-range, T] window to closed-left. This is deliberately NOT a mutation of chsql.RangeWindowFilter/windowFilterPairsFrag (builder.go ~2454-2477, the array path's own boundary predicate): that predicate sits BEHIND an equally strict scan-time WHERE (instantWindowScanBoundsFrags, pushed by pushInstantScanBound before the sample array is ever built), so mutating either one alone there is silently absorbed by the other -- confirmed by direct experiment (a Gt->Gte edit to RangeWindowFilter, and separately to instantWindowScanBoundsFrags, each left every existing and newly-added property test green). emitRangeWindowOverTimeDirectInstant's WHERE has no such redundant twin, so it is genuinely observable. gen.RangeBoundaryCase (test/property/gen/range_boundary.go) seeds one sample exactly at t=T-range (must be excluded) and one exactly at t=T (must be included). Locally reproduced end to end: the unmutated code returns the Prometheus-correct count_over_time() = 2; with this patch applied to a scratch copy the same query returns 3 (the boundary sample wrongly counted), and TestPromQL_RangeWindowBoundaryExactSample fails with exactly that drift. TestPromQL_CounterResetMidWindowCompensation (the sibling MUTANT-PROMQL-COUNTER-RESET-COMPENSATION's own detector) was re-run against this same patch and still passes, confirming the two mutants are independently attributable.
